visual.name: semanticaRenderer
visual.description: Renders Semantica visuals inside Power BI via the same primitive composition runtime as the Semantica web canvas. v4 adds direct ECharts rendering driven by a primitive spec property; v3 HTML/bar render paths are retained for backward compatibility with reports published pre-v4. v4.1 adds native slope + lollipop rendering and vertical column orientation. v4.7 adds the animated bar race (interaction · playback) with Play/scrub over a time axis.
